name: lem-hcb0-compressed-associator-CONTRACT
source: proofs/lem-hcb0-compressed-associator (af-validated, taint clean). FULL VALIDATED CONTRACT: Uniform compressed associator: there are universal C_as < infinity and e_as > 0 such that every H-CB datum with e <= e_as and all compatible amplified rectangular A,B,C satisfy ||(A dot B) dot C-A dot (B dot C)|| <= C_as*e*||A||||B||||C||.
